issues: Set-off phrased as "Forderungen … zur Verrechnung gebracht" is read as a cash payment: about 30 increases in this release that were paid entirely or partly by converting claims are shown as cash, so the conversion rule did not lower their score.
A change of capital currency (for example CHF to USD) is read as a capital increase: about 75 entries in this release are currency redenominations, not new shares.
